cases.name: Anita Louise Piteau
cases.about:
She was from Augusta, ME and 1 of 7 children. She went to CA with friends 11 months before her death. In CA she found work as a waitress. She wrote to her mother in February that she would be home in May.  She was a Jane Doe for almost 52 years.

https://bangordailynews.com/2020/07/23/news/central-maine/dna-identifies-maine-woman-as-1968-california-homicide-victim/
cases.caseStatus: CODIS / DNA MATCH; COLD CASE SOLVED; FORENSIC INVESTIGATIVE GENETIC GENEALOGY SOLVED; SUSPECT DECEASED
cases.narrative: She was raped, severely beaten, her throat slit ear to ear, and dumped out the passenger’s side of a car. Her body was discovered by three young boys playing in a large farm field in Huntington Beach. She remained unidentified for 52 years &  was the oldest Jane Doe in Orange County, CA until her identification in 2020.
